video_title: Javon Small Court Side Interview | Grizzlies vs. Timberwolves

quotes.speaker: Javon Small
quotes.summary_phrase: Javon Small on his mindset and performance during the game
quotes.excerpt: the only thing I can really control is my attitude and my effort

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Javon, congratulations on the win first of all and boy you had yourself a nice little run in that first half. How were you feeling with the ball in your hands at that point?

text_blocks.speaker: Javon Small
text_blocks.text: I was feeling confident. The past few games I really haven't been feeling it as much, but the only thing I can really control is my attitude and my effort. So, I just went out there and played my game today.

quotes.social_post: Javon Small on his performance after a tough stretch: The only thing I can really control is my attitude and my effort. So I just went out there and played my game today.

structured.context: Javon Small discusses his mindset and confidence after a strong first half performance during a courtside interview.

quotes.speaker: Javon Small
quotes.summary_phrase: Javon Small on the Grizzlies' collective team effort
quotes.excerpt: It's a collective team sport. Everybody got to show up

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: We talk about this at nauseam in terms of how well the bench played, but continues to play. Just talk about how you guys collectively have done a great job, but there have been big individual performances also.

text_blocks.speaker: Javon Small
text_blocks.text: It's a collective team sport. Everybody got to show up, whether it's one player, whether it's five players, whether it's all 18 of us. Just taking it one game at a time, but like you said, we all got to come together and that's what we're continuing to do.

quotes.social_post: Javon Small on the Grizzlies team effort: It is a collective team sport. Everybody got to show up, whether it is one player, whether it is five players, whether it is all 18 of us.

structured.context: Javon Small reflects on the importance of collective team effort and the contributions of the bench players.

quotes.speaker: Javon Small
quotes.summary_phrase: Javon Small on his shooting rhythm and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: It's all about making the right play, making the right reads

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When you get in the zone, are you just, give me the ball, I want to shoot it again? Were you in that zone, feeling that in the first quarter?

text_blocks.speaker: Javon Small
text_blocks.text: A little bit actually. After those first two, three shots go down, you want to of course take that fourth one, but it's all about making the right play, making the right reads and I feel like I've been doing pretty good with that my whole career.

quotes.social_post: Javon Small on finding his rhythm: After those first two, three shots go down, you want to of course take that fourth one, but it is all about making the right play and making the right reads.

structured.context: Javon Small explains his decision-making process and shooting rhythm when he feels he is in the zone.

quotes.speaker: Javon Small
quotes.summary_phrase: Javon Small on the importance of the NBA Cup
quotes.excerpt: It's just an opportunity to continue to get better

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Javon, getting to the group, winning the group in this NBA Cup and moving on in cup play, what does that mean for this team?

text_blocks.speaker: Javon Small
text_blocks.text: It's just an opportunity, opportunity to continue to get better, opportunity to play against other great teams, and just opportunity for us to come on top of the win.

quotes.social_post: Javon Small on the Grizzlies advancing in the NBA Cup: It is just an opportunity, opportunity to continue to get better, opportunity to play against other great teams, and just opportunity for us to come on top of the win.

structured.context: Javon Small discusses the significance of the team winning their group in the NBA Cup.

quotes.speaker: Javon Small
quotes.summary_phrase: Javon Small on the Grizzlies' grit and grind identity
quotes.excerpt: We trying to take it back to that old Memphis time

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: What is it about this team? I know Tuomas Iisalo always talks about finding a way. What is it about this team that you do manage to find a way?

text_blocks.speaker: Javon Small
text_blocks.text: Grit and grind, man. We trying to take it back to that old Memphis time. So, no complaints on our end, just whatever we going through, we know we got to do it together. Like you said, just finding a way.

quotes.social_post: Javon Small on the Grizzlies identity: Grit and grind, man. We trying to take it back to that old Memphis time. So, no complaints on our end, just whatever we going through, we know we got to do it together.

structured.context: Javon Small comments on the team's grit and grind identity and their ability to find ways to win.
